title: ko-finance-asr-corrections: Frequency-annotated Korean ASR confusion pairs from finance/stock YouTube
description:
A frequency-annotated dictionary of Korean ASR misrecognition→correction pairs mined from auto-captions of Korean finance/stock YouTube, together with a standard-library benchmark that scores fixes and over-corrections together. Every pair carries an observed corpus frequency and verification provenance (two independent LLM auditors, an external registry check, and a promotion tier). Stock names, finance terms and number damage only — no person names and no source sentences. The data is a filtered snapshot of the production correction dictionary of the 껄무새 (Ggulmuse) pipeline.

Licensing is split. The contents of data/ are CC BY 4.0; the code in benchmark/ and scripts/ is MIT. The record-level license above is the data license, because the dataset is the citable artefact.
